_comment: Reviews shown on the home page. Paste in the ones you want featured from the
Google Business Profile, then rebuild.
WHY THIS IS A FILE AND NOT A LIVE FEED: Google's Places API returns at most
five reviews and its policy forbids caching review content, so a live feed
cannot show a curated selection from 68 reviews. Featuring them here gives
full control over which ones lead.
RULES THE BUILD ENFORCES:
- A review needs both 'author' and 'text'. A half-filled entry fails the
build rather than reaching the page.
- Text that looks like placeholder copy fails the build too. The site this
replaced shipped three invented testimonials attributed to named people;
that must not happen again.
- With no usable reviews, the section becomes a plain link to Google
instead of showing filler. Nothing is ever invented to fill space.
FIELDS:
author    as it appears on Google. First name and last initial is fine.
rating    1-5. Omit or null to hide the stars on that card.
date      'YYYY-MM' or 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Rendered as 'July 2026' - absolute,
so it never becomes wrong the way '3 months ago' does.
text      the review, verbatim. Do not edit a tenant's words.
response  your public reply, if there is one. Optional.
Three or six reads best - the desktop grid is three columns, so four or
five leaves an orphan on the last row. Nine is the most it handles cleanly.
SIX BLANK SLOTS ARE BELOW. Fill author, date and text on each and rebuild.
A slot left entirely blank is ignored, so a partial fill-in still builds -
but a slot with SOME content and not all of it fails the build on purpose.
profileUrl  full Google Maps URL for the profile (google.com/maps/place/...).
Avoid share.google short links - Google retired goo.gl in 2025.
reviewUrl   the 'Ask for reviews' link from Google Business Profile,
https://g.page/r/XXXXXXXX/review - opens the star dialog directly.
rating      your overall score, e.g. 4.8. Omit to hide the aggregate.
total       total review count, for 'Read all 68 on Google'.
